en: Character packs: 06 STYLE › PRESETS now starts with CHARACTER PACKS, fan-made looks built around one character, downloaded on request and kept apart from the theme (a pack can be withdrawn without touching the theme). A card reads DOWNLOAD · size; one click downloads that pack from the releases, checks its SHA-256, installs it beside the theme (updates keep it) and applies it. Each pack names the source of its material, with links.

The first pack, SWEETPIE, for 小刻 of Arknights: Endfield: its own colour scheme, a black-and-honey-yellow case with a waffle badge (in ARRAY, GRID and the ROOM), a honey enamel title tag, waffle and three-headed-dog icons across the interface, a waffle emblem, the Signal ring as a turning waffle (in 2D and CLASSIC a dog chasing a waffle), a dog dancing to the beat in place of the Lyrics spectrum, a picture for each view and side column, the mini player in yellow, and an intro film of her arrival. Material from Hypergryph's Arknights: Endfield, used as a free fan work.

Sort by rating now follows the average shown in the album file (to one decimal): rounded to whole stars, albums rated 4.2 and 4.4 tied and fell back to the artist order, which read as no order at all. Group by rating now groups by the whole stars reached, named by their range (RATING 4.0 – 4.9, RATING 5.0), instead of rounding (which put 1.5 – 2.4 under 2).
zh: 角色包：06 外观 › 预设 最上面新增 角色包，是围绕一个角色制作的同人外观，按需下载，与主题本体分开（下架某个角色包不影响主题）。卡片上写着 下载 · 大小，点一下就从 Releases 下载这个包、用 SHA-256 校验、安装到主题旁边（更新主题不会删除）并直接应用。每个角色包都注明素材来源并附链接。

第一个角色包 SWEETPIE，主题是《明日方舟：终末地》的小刻：专属配色，黑色和蜂蜜黄的唱片盒配蜜饼徽章（陈列、网格和展室都有），蜂蜜黄搪瓷标签，整套蜜饼和三头犬图标，蜜饼徽标，可视化的环换成旋转的蜜饼（2D 和经典模式里是小狗追蜜饼），歌词页左侧的频谱换成跟着节拍跳舞的小狗，每个视图和右侧栏都有自己的背景图，黄色的迷你播放器，以及她登场的开机动画。素材来自鹰角网络《明日方舟：终末地》，作为免费同人作品使用。
按评分排序现在按专辑资料中显示的平均分（保留一位小数）排列：以前四舍五入到整星，4.2 和 4.4 被当成同分，再按艺人排序，看起来像乱序。按评分分组现在按达到的整星数分组，并标出范围（评分 4.0 – 4.9、评分 5.0），不再四舍五入（以前 1.5 – 2.4 会被归为 2 星）。
